title: add benchmark-lab profiling baselines, representative workload runners, and reporting pipeline v24
author: Aisha Kumar
description:
Motivation: consolidate the Benchmark Lab's representative workload runners, capture new profiling baselines for cold-start GPU scenarios, and wire those outputs into the reporting pipeline used by the observability team. This PR introduces: 1) three representative workload runners (streaming-chat, long-context-completion, embedding-batch) that match production request shapes; 2) updated profiling baselines for cold-start and warm-start GPU profiles (A100/RTX6000) including memory and kernel-level traces; 3) an upgraded reporting pipeline (ci/pipelines/benchmark-reporting.yaml) that publishes summarized metrics (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, memory-peak) to the benchmark S3 bucket and triggers the performance dashboard refresh. The description below is a single continuous string that includes the checklist, test notes, and links. Checklist:
- [x] representative runners: streaming-chat, long-context-completion, embedding-batch
- [x] profiling harness and baselines for cold-start and warm-start
- [x] reporting pipeline changes and S3 artifact layout v3
- [x] dashboard update & alert thresholds adjusted
- [x] unit + integration tests for runners + reporting job
- [x] docs: benchmark-lab/README.md updated with runner usage
Testing notes: Runners were executed against internal staging models and small open models to validate shapes. Profiling runs were executed on A100 and RTX6000 nodes; artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-benchmark-artifacts/v24/. CI runs included the new benchmark reporting job; an intermittent Amazon S3 permission flake required a one-time rerun of the pipeline (see CI history). Related linear tasks: ENG-7453 (benchmark lab consolidation), ENG-7521 (profiling baselines), ENG-7589 (reporting pipeline v3). Related PRs: pr-61235 (v23 profiling baselines) and pr-58910 (initial representative runners). Impact: framework changes are additive and opt-in; no breaking API changes to runtime. Release notes: adds new benchmark lab runners and reporting pipeline v24; operators can opt in to publish baselines for their private deployments.

review_thread: Jordan Patel (reviewer): Can you add a short note describing the input distributions for each runner? We should ensure they reflect production percentiles.
Aisha Kumar (author): Added distribution notes to runner headers and updated README with percentiles used (p50/p90/p99).
Nina Roberts (reviewer): The S3 layout change needs to be compatible with the dashboard ingestion job. Confirmed with observability that v3 is safe; updated the dashboard config to pull v3 prefixes.
Samir Vora (reviewer): Integration tests flaked on S3 permission, but reran and green. Please add retry logic to the uploader to reduce flakes.
Aisha Kumar (author): Added exponential backoff retry and increased timeout on uploader (see ci/pipelines update). All reviewers approved and requested squash merge.
release_notes: Adds benchmark-lab v24: three representative runners, profiling baselines for cold/warm GPU starts, and a v3 reporting pipeline that publishes summarized metrics to s3://redwood-benchmark-artifacts/v24/.
test_plan: Unit tests for runners and uploader; integration test exercising full reporting pipeline against a small model in staging; manual profiling runs on A100/RTX6000 nodes. See tests/benchmark/README.md for instructions.
notes: This PR is part of the Benchmark Lab consolidation initiative. Operators who rely on the previous v2 layout should coordinate a one-time migration; both v2 and v3 layouts are supported by the dashboard for 30 days post-merge.
